shortDescription: Manage secrets engines within HashiCorp Vault

options.name: allowed_response_headers
options.description: Headers that the plugin is allowed to return.

options.name: audit_non_hmac_request_keys
options.description: Request keys that should not be hashed in the audit logs.

options.name: audit_non_hmac_response_keys
options.description: Response keys that should not be hashed in the audit logs.

options.name: client_cert
options.description: PEM formatted certificate chain file to be used for TLS client authentication. This file can also include the key as well, and if the key is included, C(client_key) is not required.

options.name: client_key
options.description: PEM formatted file that contains your private key to be used for TLS client authentication. If C(client_cert) contains both the certificate and key, this option is not required.

options.name: default_lease_ttl
options.description: Default lease duration, in seconds. I(0) will use the system default.

options.name: description
options.description: Description of the mount point.

options.name: external_entropy_access
options.description: Allow access to Vault's external entropy source. B(ENTERPRISE ONLY)

options.name: force
options.description: Allow deletion of existing mounts with an incompatible type.

options.name: force_no_cache
options.description: Disable caching.

options.name: http_agent
options.description: Header to identify as, generally appears in web server logs.

options.name: listing_visibility
options.description: Whether the mount should be shown in the UI.

options.name: local
options.description: Whether this mount is cluster-wide or local to this node. B(ENTERPRISE ONLY)

options.name: max_lease_ttl
options.description: Maximum lease duration, in seconds. I(0) will use the system default.

options.name: options
options.description: Options to pass to the engine.

options.name: passthrough_request_headers
options.description: Headers that should be passed from the request to the plugin.

options.name: path
options.description: Mount path.

options.name: plugin_version
options.description: Semantic version of the plugin to use, e.g. "v1.0.0" If blank the engine will select a registered unversioned plugin, the best registered versioned plugin, or a built-in plugin (in that order of precendence.)

options.name: seal_wrap
options.description: Enable seal wrapping. B(ENTERPRISE ONLY)

options.name: state
options.description: Desired mount state.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Request timeout, in seconds.

options.name: token
options.description: Authentication token to use. If this is not set then the contents of C(~/.vault-token) will be checked.

options.name: type
options.description: Engine to mount on this path. Required when I(state=present)

options.name: use_proxy
options.description: If C(no), it will not use a proxy, even if one is defined in an environment variable on the target hosts.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(no), TLS certificates will not be validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.

options.name: vault_addr
options.description: Location of the Vault service.
